item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 6
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 6. In the end of the last episode, Chabashira taught them there will be next exam, and it was going to be the biggest exam. This episode is whole about that preparation before that exam. Koenji may have a problem but he isn't worried at all and planned to do something. Ike had a crash on Shinohara but he couldn't ask her to join to a group on the next exam and she somehow joined with guys in the class B. Ike was actually pretty good at surviving in an island, which he showed in the last year, so that's why Ayanokoji cared him in this episode. Matsushita sneaked Ayanokoji and tried to ask him to be a group, too. This guy is smart and evaluates a person appropriately.

Interesting scene was Sakayanagi talked to Ichinose and Sakayanagi was surprised when Ichinose counter argued with Sakayanagi. She is excessively confident as she usually is, but also she underestimated Ichinose. Acting and animation of this Sakayanagi's reaction are better and bigger than I originally thought, maybe because of her confidence and her original prediction.

item.title: Watching Oshi no Ko season 3 episode 6
item.description:
Episode 6 was about mainly about an entertainment industry in Japan and Kana. In the last episode, Kana went to a director's office and a journalist took her photo for a gossip. This episode was all about how a male idol meeting with a woman or a female idol meeting with a man and someone got known to that. On the earlier part, Ruby was really not interested with a romantic relationship and thought SNS changed an idol who actually had a romantic relationship started not coming under fire. However, in the later of this episode, Kana thought about how an idol dooms when they have a hidden romantic relationship and someone expose it, and they get flammed, which was actually the old thing from what Ruby thought. Kana has seen the old days of the industry because she has worked since she was a child, and also it was now her turn to come under fire, so she thought what would come from a negative side. I felt a little bit weird that she was so gloomy and naive.... but well, actually, she is naive person.

Also, compared to manga, this scene was over dramatized, apparently. If I remember correctly, these episodes were also flammed in the SNS on the manga, so anime production may try to make watchers sympathize more, or at least that's what I felt.
